Organic fertilizer manufacturer in Gujarat
Gujarat Bio Organics Private Limited makes organic fertilizers, biofertilizers and biostimulants at its own factory in Shihor, Bhavnagar, and supplies farmers, dealers and bulk buyers across India.

Gujarat Bio Organics is an organic fertilizer, biofertilizer and biostimulant manufacturer in Bhavnagar, Gujarat. We have worked with farmers since 2006, make every product at our own factory in Shihor, and hold No Objection Certificates from the Directorate of Agriculture, Government of Gujarat for 36 Schedule VI biostimulant grades and 11 biofertilizer types.

Questions about us
Is Gujarat Bio Organics a manufacturer or a trader?
We are a manufacturer. Every Immunity product is made at our own factory in Shihor, Bhavnagar, Gujarat, by the same team that visits farms.
Plot No. 321, GIDC 2, Ghanghali Road, Shihor, Bhavnagar, Gujarat 364240. Bulk, OEM and dealer partners can ask to visit; contact us to arrange a time.
Which approvals do you hold?
The Directorate of Agriculture, Government of Gujarat has issued No Objection Certificates to Gujarat Bio Organics for 36 Schedule VI biostimulant grades and 11 biofertilizer types.
Do you supply outside Gujarat?
Yes. We dispatch across India and abroad. Farmers can order on WhatsApp, and dealers and bulk buyers can write to us directly.
Do you do OEM or private label manufacturing?
Yes. Brands and formulators can ask for OEM and private label supply; see the OEM and private label page for how to start.
